model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of knowledge probing after editing with different editing methods on BioMedLM, comparing various models. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number", has a logarithmic scale, ranges from 10^0 to 10^4, and has tick labels at intervals of 10^1. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)", has a linear scale, ranges from 40 to 65, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot contains five lines representing different models: "Base" (black, circle marker, solid line) starts at approximately 41% and increases to around 57%; "FT" (green, triangle marker, solid line) begins at about 41% and rises to roughly 53%; "IKE" (blue, square marker, solid line) starts at approximately 41% and reaches around 60%; "MEND" (red, diamond marker, solid line) begins at about 42% and increases to roughly 62%; and "MEMIT" (purple, cross marker, dashed line) starts at approximately 42% and rises to around 61%. All lines generally trend upward as the co-occurrence number increases.
